channel.title: The One Show
channel.desc: An extended 20th-anniversary special sees Alex Jones and Roman Kemp bring together some of the biggest names, favourite stories and standout moments from the show. Joined by the wider family of presenters, they look back at the inspiring stories that have shaped the programme, from its Children in Need fundraising legacy to the impact it has had on viewers. Plus a special music performance to mark the occasion.
